overview.about: The Rocket Classic is a PGA Tour event at the historic Detroit Golf Club, a Donald Ross design in the heart of the city. Bringing top-level golf back to Detroit, it is a relatively gettable, birdie-friendly summer stop.
overview.nextEvent: The next Rocket Classic is played at Detroit Golf Club. The classic parkland layout and receptive greens tend to produce low winning scores in front of enthusiastic local crowds.
